stories.title: El Barça de Raphinha revienta a un enérgico Sevilla

en.title: Barça's Raphinha demolishes energetic Sevilla
en.summary: Raphinha scored a hat-trick to lead Barcelona's second-half comeback against Sevilla. Barcelona dominated the second half after Sevilla's strong first-half performance.

stories.title: Un divino Raphinha anota otro hat-trick y mantiene el ritmo del Barça ante un valiente Sevilla

en.title: Divine Raphinha scores another hat-trick and maintains Barcelona's pace against brave Sevilla
en.summary: Raphinha achieved his hat-trick with assists from Lamine, leading Barcelona's comeback against Sevilla. The Brazilian has scored 12 goals in seven matches this season.

stories.title: Raphinha eleva al Barça en Sevilla

en.title: Raphinha elevates Barcelona in Sevilla
en.summary: Barcelona began the match with its usual dominant approach, with Livaković starting in goal in place of the injured Joan García. The hosts struggled to gain initiative against Barcelona's pressure.

stories.title: A Raphinha no hay quien le pare: el brasileño lidera al Barça en Sevilla con un hat-trick

en.title: Raphinha unstoppable: Brazilian leads Barcelona in Sevilla with hat-trick
en.summary: Raphinha scored all three goals as Barcelona came from behind to win, marking Livaković's debut in goal for the club. The Brazilian's performance proved decisive in the match.

stories.title: Collboni se adelanta a Sánchez y se reúne en Nueva York con el alcalde Zohran Mamdani, la antítesis política de Donald Trump

en.title: Collboni advances ahead of Sánchez and meets in New York with Mayor Zohran Mamdani, the political antithesis of Donald Trump
en.summary: Barcelona's PSC mayor announced a pilot program for affordable stores while attending the Urban20 mayors summit in New York this weekend, ahead of the Spanish government president's US visit next week.

stories.title: Collboni anuncia en Nueva York la apertura de tiendas asequibles en Barcelona

en.title: Collboni announces in New York the opening of affordable stores in Barcelona
en.summary: Barcelona's mayor announced an initiative to open affordable retail stores in the Marina neighborhood starting next year.

stories.title: Collboni anuncia tras reunirse con Mamdani que planea abrir en Barcelona supermercados asequibles como en Nueva York

en.title: Collboni announces after meeting with Mamdani that he plans to open affordable supermarkets in Barcelona like in New York
en.summary: The socialist mayor, participating in the Urban 20 summit gathering representatives from 34 G-20 cities, announced plans for affordable supermarkets modeled on New York's approach.

stories.title: Dinamarca y Groenlandia celebran un acuerdo con Estados Unidos lleno de incógnitas

en.title: Denmark and Greenland celebrate an agreement with the United States full of uncertainties
en.summary: Copenhagen and Nuuk announced a pact with the United States that they say respects Danish sovereignty, though some experts question whether it fully resolves all disputes.

stories.title: La OTAN celebra el acuerdo sobre Groenlandia por su importancia para la seguridad del Ártico

en.title: NATO celebrates Greenland agreement for Arctic security importance
en.summary: NATO welcomed an agreement involving Greenland, citing its strategic significance for Arctic security. Denmark and Greenland stated the accord does not transfer sovereignty despite Trump's claimed demands for permanent control.

stories.title: La OTAN acoge con “satisfacción” el acuerdo de EE UU y Dinamarca sobre Groenlandia

en.title: NATO welcomes "satisfaction" on US and Denmark agreement regarding Greenland
en.summary: NATO has expressed satisfaction with an agreement reached among the United States, Denmark, and Greenland, stating it will promote security, stability, and cooperation.

stories.title: Estados Unidos alcanza un acuerdo de seguridad con Groenlandia

en.title: United States reaches security agreement with Greenland
en.summary: The United States and Greenland have signed a security agreement that increases American military presence on the Arctic island, though falling short of broader control objectives previously indicated.

stories.title: Dinamarca matiza que el pacto con Estados Unidos sobre Groenlandia será de “seguridad compartida”

en.title: Denmark clarifies that pact with United States on Greenland will be of "shared security"
en.summary: Danish Prime Minister Mette Frederiksen stated that any agreement recognizes the kingdom's sovereignty and territorial integrity, as well as the Greenlandic people's right to self-determination.

stories.title: La demanda de alquiler se traslada de las capitales a ciudades más pequeñas

en.title: Rental demand shifts from capital cities to smaller towns
en.summary: Rental interest is moving away from major cities toward smaller municipalities with more affordable prices, such as Getafe near Madrid and Cornellà near Barcelona.

stories.title: Llega la nueva era de la guerra controlada con IA

en.title: A new era of controlled warfare with AI arrives
en.summary: The Ukraine conflict is accelerating military innovation with AI-controlled drones, shifting global military strategy toward automation while raising concerns about delegating lethal decisions to machines.

stories.title: ¿Podemos fiarnos de la nueva IA médica?

en.title: Can we trust the new medical AI?
en.summary: While artificial intelligence offers potential healthcare advances, lack of transparency in medical algorithms poses patient risks, prompting calls for real-world testing and independent oversight.

stories.title: Chips: los soportes esperan más abajo

en.title: Chips: supports await lower
en.summary: The SOX chip index shows a strong support level in the 10,000-10,200 points range.

stories.title: La IA no vuelve al cole este curso en la Gran Manzana

en.title: AI does not return to school this academic year in the Big Apple
en.summary: New York City's mayor has banned artificial intelligence use in primary school classrooms for the 2026-2027 school year, while secondary students will receive instruction on AI risks and biases.
